findings: RR already owns REPORT_RECORD write authority in RDG v1.
RRE-W14 already grants RR read-only REALITY_READOUT_RECORD.
RR v2 section model additionally needs read-only Runtime State, Method Projection, Meaning Projection and Navigation records.
Published Knowledge, Published Assets, Service Contracts and future governed Metrics remain external reference authorities, not RR-owned data.
decision: Use versioned read-only successor extension; do not rewrite canonical-data-contract-registry-v1.json.
